verdict.rationale: Tilled documents a per-merchant application status model (`created`/`started`) where ops can pre-fill and edit applications on behalf of merchants. It also offers custom (OnboardingJS) and no-code onboarding flows run through the Partner Dashboard, which gives some control over onboarding friction. Nothing shows progressive or staged KYC, where sellers can start selling with minimal data and the rest is collected before payout thresholds, or requirements-due states per seller. Missing for 10: progressive KYC that allows selling before full verification, payout-threshold-gated requirement collection, explicit per-seller requirements/due-date states, and independent corroboration.
